brief:
The Arab League issued a warning over what it characterized as dangerous Israeli plans in the Negev and Galilee regions, according to Maan Wire. The statement underscores ongoing Arab concerns regarding Israeli policy initiatives in these strategically significant areas of historic dispute.

The League's alert reflects deepening regional tensions over Israeli activities in territories and zones of contested control. No immediate details were provided regarding the specific nature of the plans or potential Arab League responses to the developments.
title: Arab League warns of Israeli plans in Negev and Galilee
